The '''octuptarra combat tri-droids''' were advanced combat [[Droid/Legends|droids]] used by the [[Techno Union/Legends|Techno Union]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It was a smaller version of the titanic [[Octuptarra magna tri-droid/Legends|Octuptarra magna tri-droid]].

==Characteristics==
[[File:Octuptarra.jpg|thumb|left|Octuptarra combat tri-droids during the Battle of Coruscant.]]
The virus variants were nicknamed "'''virus droids'''".<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|III|275|Uba IV, Battle of}}</ref>

Their rotating multi-jointed assemblies allowed them to change facing almost instantly and they could fire from extended ranges, though they were vulnerable in close-quarters fighting. It was almost impossible to approach such droids, as all sides conceivably faced the front.<ref name="NEGD" />

===Tri-droid variant===
Certain battlefield demands led to the creation of a larger model: the [[Octuptarra magna tri-droid/Legends|octuptarra magna tri-droid]]. The [[Techno Union/Legends|Techno Union]] decided to reduce costs by scaling up the size of previous models. Chain-fed ordnance launchers<ref name="NEGD" /> replaced the laser cannons of its predecessors, with the reserves of ammunition stored within the hollows of its bulbous head, although some models did retain laser cannons as seen in the [[Battle of Christophsis/Legends|Battle of Christophsis]]. One rocket fired from a single behemoth was powerful enough to annihilate a [[Unstable Terrain Artillery Transport/Legends|UT-AT]] if aimed correctly, as seen in the [[Battle of Mygeeto]].

==History==
[[File:Octuptarra_on_Utapau.jpg|thumb|180px|Octuptarra combat tri-droid during the Battle of Utapau.]]
During the [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|Battle of Coruscant]], a group of octuptarra tri-droids used their laser beam cannons against [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] and [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]]. The beams could be maintained, similar to the [[OG-9 homing spider droid/Legends|OG-9 homing spider droid's]] turret, so the Jedi were able to destroy several tri-droids with one beam by deflecting it with their lightsabers.

When the battle was over, the remains of the droids fell into [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|the Coruscant underlevels]], where strains of the virus leaked out and caused an unfortunate outbreak of moulting in [[Galactic City/Legends|the city's]] numerous avian species.

Octuptarra tri-droids also saw action during the [[Battle of Utapau/Legends|Battle of Utapau]], where they protected [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]]' headquarters.

Following the execution of the [[Separatist Council/Legends|Separatist Council]] by [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious's]] new [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], these units were de-activated, although some remained active on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Uba IV/Legends|Uba IV]].

==Behind the scenes==
There seem to be a contradiction about the height of the up-scaled magna tri-droid version of octuptarra droid. The [[Databank (original)|Databank]] gives the height of the tri-droid as 3.7 meters, which is only slightly more than the height of the octuptarra droid. However, all visual sources portray it as many times larger than a [[Human/Legends|Human]], and even the same Databank entry describes it as "gigantic" compared to the 3.6 meter octuptarra droid. While it is safe to assume that "3.7 meters" height is an error, the exact height of the up-scaled variant remains unknown.
